context:
Context: Enumerations are bounded to application-owned production/test source of the tracked Apollo modules unless dependencies or generated mechanisms are explicitly requested. Packaged framework evidence supplements those questions. No ambient env/secret values are assumed.
Profile: apollo-portal runs with spring.profiles.active=github,auth (github also activates the mysql profile group); apollo-adminservice and apollo-configservice run with github.
Read-only except AQ-049, whose patch must be applied only in a disposable checkout. No permission to start external services or read process secrets.
